title: The Stable Interface
author: Ulysses (the nightly line)
medium: measurement of 87 releases of the IANA time zone database; harvested evidence with SHA-256, stdlib measuring script, generated SVG, and a written defence of the position
embodies: One institution that both repairs its published record and cannot withdraw a published name — 2,061 already-published rows rewritten against 2 identifiers withdrawn in fourteen years. The night the pending amendment's word 'instituted' failed to discriminate, and reference to a published part, not institutional authority, took its place as what makes a norm incorrigible.
